name: estate-platform
description: Real estate marketplace and business management platform (modular monolith).

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis mailpit
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web,console -c gray,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @estate/shared" "npm run dev -w @estate/api" "npm run dev -w @estate/web" "npm run dev -w @estate/console"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @estate/shared && npm run build -w @estate/api && npm run build -w @estate/web && npm run build -w @estate/console
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @estate/api && npm run typecheck -w @estate/web && npm run typecheck -w @estate/console
scripts.test: npm run test -w @estate/shared && npm run test -w @estate/api
